title: Kubernetes: Zero to Production
description: Pods to production platforms: notes, phase guides and 46 hands-on labs, from fundamentals to AWS EKS.

modules.title: Fundamentals
modules.description: Pods, ReplicaSets, Deployments, Services, namespaces and resource management (Notes #1-#10).

modules.title: Application Deployment
modules.description: ConfigMaps, Secrets, health probes, storage and StatefulSets.

modules.title: Networking & Security
modules.description: Ingress, Gateway API, DNS, RBAC, ServiceAccounts and NetworkPolicy.

modules.title: Scaling & Operations
modules.description: HPA, Jobs, DaemonSets, advanced scheduling, graceful shutdown and node operations.

modules.title: Production Platform
modules.description: Helm, Prometheus, Loki, CI/CD, Argo CD, Argo Rollouts and security hardening.

modules.title: AWS EKS
modules.description: EKS architecture, VPC networking, IAM, Terraform, load balancing, storage and Karpenter.
